title: Kijimi Survivors
description: The mood of battle turns quickly for the Resistance. Poe hears a familiar voice cry out over the comm system: "So long. Sky-trash!" "Who's that flyer?" he fires back! "Take a guess. Spice runner!" "Zorii, you made it!" cries Poe, as Babu Frik pops up and shouts "Hey, hey!" all while the Resistance and their allies zoom past exploding Star Destroyers.
